title: Billing Office Posting Rule: Monthly Equipment Billing of Home Oxygen Therapy
content:
# Monthly Equipment Billing — Home Oxygen Therapy

## 1. Billing day and month number

Each month of the payment period of a Home Oxygen Therapy rental is billed on the anniversary of the payment-period start date: the same day of each later calendar month, falling back to the last day of a shorter month. After a resumption the next month starts on the resumption date.

The month number is the next ordinal after the paid months of the current payment period. The paid months of the current payment period are the paid equipment-month lines of the oxygen record under the coverage the record names, whose month began on or after the payment-period start date, up to the handling date, less the reversals recorded against one of those lines.

## 2. The month's fee

> Clause retired in part: "The month's fee is the class's stationary monthly fee, adjusted for the prescribed flow in force on the month's first day: above the high-flow threshold the stationary fee rises by the high-flow uplift percentage." This clause is no longer in force for an equipment month that the coverage paid in full, leaving no patient share because the plan's out-of-pocket maximum was already met. Every other equipment month remains under this clause for its fee.

The following parts of the fee rule remain in force:

- A month above the high-flow threshold carries modifier QG, or QF when portable equipment is furnished, in which case the portable add-on is not paid on top of the uplift and the higher of the two amounts applies: the higher of the stationary fee raised by the uplift, and the stationary fee plus the portable add-on.
- Below the low-flow threshold the stationary fee falls by the low-flow reduction percentage (modifier QE); the month's fee is then the reduced stationary fee plus the portable add-on.
- The portable add-on is added when portable equipment is furnished and billable.

## 3. Allowed amount

> Clause retired in part: "The allowed amount is the fee times the coverage class's allowed percentage of the fee schedule divided by 100, rounded to the cent half up." This clause is no longer in force for an equipment month that the coverage paid in full, leaving no patient share because the plan's out-of-pocket maximum was already met. Every other equipment month remains under this clause for its allowed amount.

## 4. Contents

Contents are included during the payment period and never billed separately in it.

## 5. Group II months from month 4

For a group II patient, months from month 4 are payable only when a repeat test between the class's earliest and latest repeat-test days of therapy again qualifies; otherwise they are denied as retest missing.

## 6. Billable status

An equipment month is billed only while the oxygen record is an active rental. The basis is the system record: the status the oxygen record shows.

## 7. Codes on the line

The line carries the class's stationary equipment code, with the portable equipment code riding on it.

## Status check (illustration)

| Status of the oxygen record | Equipment month barred by the status condition |
|---|---|
| active rental | no |
| suspended, payment cap reached, returned, or any other status | yes |

## Billing days (hypothetical)

| Payment-period start date | Later billing days |
|---|---|
| 15 March | 15 April, 15 May, 15 June |
| 31 January | 28 February (29 February in a leap year), 31 March, 30 April |

The allowed amount is the fee times the coverage class's allowed_pct_of_fee_schedule divided by 100, rounded to the cent half up.
